case_title: RICARDO MORENO VS. NEW MEXICO IRON WORK et al

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - NON-VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF MORENO, RICARDO AS TO DEFENDANT NEW MEXICO IRON WORK JUAREZ, BENITO DOES 1 TO 10 SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR AUG-06-2004 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  MAY-03-2004 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         JUL-22-2004
ADDED TO PROOF OF SERVICE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE CALENDAR HEARING SET FOR JUL-06-2004 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 212
MINI-MINUTES FOR JUL-06-2004 9:00 AM FOR DEPT 212

SANCTIONS OF $200.00 AGAINST RICARDO MORENO, FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: JUL-06-2004 PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE JUL-21-2004. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY: LISA SARTO, CSR#8994 (212) NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR SEP-20-2004 IN DEPARTMENT 212 AT 1:30 PM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE AUG-06-2004 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI-MINUTES FOR SEP-20-2004 1:30 PM FOR DEPT 212

SANCTIONS ORDERED IN THE AMOUNT OF $350.00 AGAINST RICARDO MORENO, FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: SEP-20-2004, PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE OCT-05-2004. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY: JOE VICKSTEIN (212)

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR SEP-20-2004 CONTINUED TO NOV-22-2004 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 212 FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI-MINUTES FOR NOV-22-2004 1:30 PM FOR DEPT 212

CASE DISMISSED , AS TO ENTIRE ACTION BY COURT AT ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING NOV-22-2004 AT 1:30PM. THE COURT FINDS NO GOOD CAUSE OR SUBSTANTIAL JUSTIFICATION FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE PREVIOUS COURT ORDERS. A LESS SEVERE SANCTION WOULD NOT BE EFFECTIVE DUE TO THE HISTORY OF LACK OF COMPLIANCE. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY: LA VENA WARD, CSR NO. 7077. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
